component.name: argus
component.description: macOS log + syslog analysis with CrowdSec, threat feeds and OSINT enrichment

properties.name: cdx:argus:note
properties.value: Generated from app/package-lock.json (npm deps) plus hand-added entries for the Docker base images, apk packages baked into image/Dockerfile, and the CDN-loaded dashboard JS/CSS in app/public/index.html, none of which an npm-only SBOM tool can see. CDN libraries use floating major-version tags (e.g. chart.js@4) by design (see image/Dockerfile / app/public/index.html for exact pins at build time); re-generate app/package-lock.json components with `npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm --output-format JSON --output-file sbom.json` from app/, the apk/CDN/image entries must be re-added by hand or scripted.
